dedupe_keys.name: synthetic european energy community with 250 homes and 500 electric vehicles

description: The Polytechnic of Porto’s GECAD group constructed an energy-community scenario containing 250 households, 200 photovoltaic owners, 150 household batteries and 500 electric vehicles. Consumption and generation profiles derived from measurements in Portugal, Britain and France were transformed and randomly assigned to the households. Vehicle capacity, state of charge and usage are accompanied by public-charger location, type and operating-cost information. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook and a DOCX description free under CC BY 4.0. This is a synthetic European scenario, not observations of one existing community; the short repository description does not establish a common calendar period or interval for every field. Random assignment limits interpretation of actual correlations between household demand and vehicle use. A reviewer-assessed use is testing coordinated charging, storage and prosumer scheduling simulations. model-pypsa is a related energy-system tool, while data-low-carbon-london-smart-meter-households is an identified upstream measurement source. No optimized outcome or direct tool compatibility was checked.
